inscription.name: Ramsundsristningen

carrier.currentLocationDescription: Nuvarande placering: Ramsundsberget, Mora, Jäders socken

textLayer.readingTransliteration: siriþr : kiarþi : bur : þosi : muþiʀ : alriks : tutiʀ : urms : fur · salu : hulmkirs : faþur : sukruþar buata · sis ·
textLayer.normalizationRunicSwedish: Sigriðr gærði bro þasi, moðiʀ Alriks, dottiʀ Orms, for salu Holmgæiʀs, faður Sigrøðaʀ, boanda sins.
textLayer.normalizationOldWestNorse: Sigríðr gerði brú þessa, móðir Alríks, dóttir Orms, fyrir sálu Holmgeirs, fǫður Sigrøðar, bónda síns.
textLayer.translationSwedish: Sigrid, Alriks moder, Orms dotter, gjorde denna bro för sin make Holmgers, Sigröds faders, själ. Torir ristade.
textLayer.translationEnglish: Sigríðr, Alríkr's mother, Ormr's daughter, made this bridge for the soul of Holmgeirr, father of Sigrøðr, her husbandman. Þórir carved.

images.caption: Ramsundsristningen (Sö 101), Sigurdsristningen på berghäll vid Sundbyholm

inscription.editorialNotes: Ramsundsristningen på en slät berghäll vid Sundbyholm. Ristad med scener ur Sigurdssagan: smeden Regin, draken Fafne, Sigurd grillande drakhjärtat och hästen Grane.
